facts.situation: Margaret Hughes is retired, with no changes to her circumstances or objectives since the previous review. She remains comfortable with risk profile 4 (moderate) and is satisfied that portfolio performance has been in line with this approach. She wants to use this year's ISA allowance with cash held on deposit in her Holloway cash account. Her existing Stocks & Shares ISA is held in her sole name. She has no current portfolio income requirement and does not expect this to change in the near term. Gifting to grandchildren is a possible future discussion only; no action is agreed.

actions.action: Move available cash from Holloway cash account H-CASH-01 to top up existing Stocks & Shares ISA H-ISA-01, without selling existing investments.
